beginner.title: Get started with Spread The Sign

beginner.title: Turn it on and set it up
beginner.outcome: You can: start using Spread The Sign

beginner.title: Everyday tasks
beginner.outcome: You can: use Spread The Sign for daily tasks

intermediate.title: Customise
intermediate.outcome: You can: tailor Spread The Sign to you

intermediate.title: Work and study
intermediate.outcome: You can: use Spread The Sign at work or school
intermediate.practice: Use Spread The Sign in one meeting or class

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Spread The Sign
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Spread The Sign distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Spread The Sign
expert.outcome: You can: use Spread The Sign's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Support and advocate
expert.outcome: You can: help others and test accessibility
expert.practice: Test a document or website with Spread The Sign

expert.title: Integrate Spread The Sign into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Spread The Sign with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Spread The Sign to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Spread The Sign well
